caveats: One frozen real rollout and current small architecture; not a full training run.
Batch size 128 changes PPO optimization and is not learning-equivalent to batch size 16.
Warm timing excludes first full update; cold results retained.
Background load and temperature are uncontrolled.
Stage diagnostic adds synchronization and uses one fixed batch; not an additive full-update profile.

inputs.scope: Training split only; real frozen rollout reused for isolated device comparisons; no research-model promotion.

batch-128.caveat: Device arithmetic need not be bitwise equal; repeated frozen-rollout speed test, not a learning-quality experiment.

batch-16.caveat: Device arithmetic need not be bitwise equal; repeated frozen-rollout speed test, not a learning-quality experiment.

stage_diagnostic.caveat: One fixed real 16-decision graph batch, five warmups, twenty samples, extra synchronization at every stage. This is a diagnostic, not the full-update speed estimate.
